allowLowerCamelCase.description:
Will match pattern even if first letter of input string is lower case. E.g. "asBoolean" will match camel case
pattern "AB" only if `allowLowerCamelCase` is `true`.

title:
A C3 Type that represents "Camel Case Pattern".

E.g. string "AbstractBaseClass" will match against patterns such as "ABC", "AB", "BC", "Base" etc.
name: CamelCasePattern
